content.short: Waffle is a TypeScript-compatible smart contract testing library for Ethereum that works with ethers.js.
content.description: Waffle is an advanced contract testing tool built by the TrueFi engineering team, offering a simple interface and fast test compilation and execution. It provides a rich set of chai-style matchers, straightforward npm import and export, fixtures to write and maintain tests, and thorough documentation. Together, these features deliver a streamlined library for writing Solidity smart contracts and validating their behavior with reliable, repeatable tests.
content.meta: Waffle is a TypeScript-compatible smart contract testing library for Ethereum using ethers.js. Discover Waffle and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
